meta.source: AF Form 910, Enlisted Performance Report (AB thru TSgt) (20151130, V4)
meta.notes: Read from the form's own XFA template by src/lib/pdf (tests/fixtures/forms/af910-20151130-blank.pdf), which opens the e-Publishing PDF with its empty user password and reads each <field> box, <font> and <margin>. tests/data-integrity.test.ts re-reads that fixture and fails if any value here drifts from it. widthMm is the width text can occupy: the field box less any side insets, and none of these blocks has one, so it is the box width pdf-bullets also uses. heightMm is the field box; lines stays null until the row count Acrobat lays out in it has been measured against a real print. Times New Roman is the form's face; we ship Liberation Serif, which is metrically identical and redistributable under the SIL Open Font License.
